<!-- pr-reviewer: b53939e89ff7b44e6a3b922dfbec3fbed690a709 -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good
- One helper `layout::keep_scroll_gutter` now holds the gutter rule that the Post dialog (#3384) and the operation page each repeated. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/scroll_gutter.rs:13`
- The pinning test is a real pointer click through the harness and asserts the option through the document, not a pixel. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_post_gap_tests.rs:24`
- New files carry provenance lines. No snapshot PNG changed. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests. No new crate dependency.

## Results
Built on the self-hosted runner (pr-test.yml), run 45028116164 (https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45028116164), merged trial with main `b44a422bbc5`:

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| The head is the one the reviewer read | ok |
| Trial merge with main | clean (also verified locally with `git merge-tree`: no conflict) |
| Quick gate: ui build, ui lib, 8 ui suites | ok, 10 steps, 0 failed |
| clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

Not built locally (disk guard, 2026-11-22); the runner result stands. The diff has no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS pinned values, so no Windows re-run is owed.

## Heavy lanes
The diff touches `camcraft-ui` files only. The heavy crates are kernel, motion and app (`xtask/src/plan.rs:190`), and none of them depends on `ui`. The diff reaches no heavy lane. Confirmed by reading, not by a local build.

## Law check
- Placement: the new test file imports `crate::state` and `super::pages`, so `camcraft-ui` is the lowest crate that provides what it imports. Correct.
- Everything Is a Command: the click toggles the option through the existing undoable command path. The test proves it reads back.
- Process: commit subject is conventional, body has `Changelog:` and ends `Fixes #3390`. No process file, no `PROCESS_VERSION` edit, no CHANGELOG edit.
- UI rules: the `#[test]` count goes up, no layout or structural test deleted, no PNG touched.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `properties_body` now keeps the gutter on every page that uses it (Stock, WCS, Model, Setups), so those pages are 15-19 px narrower when they scroll. The same shadowing bug the PR fixes on the Post page can exist on those pages, so the widening looks right. No test asserts a size there. If the maintainer wants the gutter only on Post, move the call into the `UiTarget::SetupNode(SetupPage::Post)` arm. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:118`
- The `match` in `properties_body` gained a nesting level without re-indent, by choice. Fine; a later fmt commit can settle it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
